user.title: ipTIME Router Setup
user.description: Enter the router administrator credentials. Include the port in the address when needed.{error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the router. Check its address, port, and network reachability from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: The administrator username or password is incorrect.
error.captcha_required: Interactive CAPTCHA authentication is enabled on the router. Change the administrator login authentication setting.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not automatically discover the router.

init.title: ipTIME management
init.description: You're currently tracking {tracked_count} device(s). Choose what you'd like to do.

dhcp_select.title: Choose a device to reserve
dhcp_select.description: Already reserved devices are excluded. Choose a connected device to prefill its MAC, IP and name, or enter an offline device manually.

dhcp_add.title: Add DHCP reservation
dhcp_add.description: Saving changes the router configuration. The integration checks IP conflicts and the LAN subnet, then reads back the result. {error_detail}

dhcp_manage_select.title: Choose a reservation to edit or delete
dhcp_manage_select.description: The current reservation list was read from the router and is sorted by numeric IP.

dhcp_edit.title: Edit DHCP reservation
dhcp_edit.description: Change the IP or description for MAC {mac}. Conflicts are checked before saving and the result is read back. {error_detail}

dhcp_delete_confirm.title: Confirm reservation deletion
dhcp_delete_confirm.description: Delete the reservation for {ip} · {name} · {mac}. The current connection is not immediately interrupted, but the IP may change at the next DHCP renewal. {error_detail}

add_select.title: Choose devices to add
add_select.description: Only devices the router currently reports - connected now, or with a named static-IP reservation - that aren't already tracked are shown. Select one or more devices to add.

add_nickname.title: Name this device ({position}/{total})

manage_select.title: Choose a device to edit
manage_select.description: You're currently tracking {tracked_count} device(s). Pick one to rename or stop tracking. Choose Done when you're finished to save your changes.

data.remove: Stop tracking this device (removes its entity)

settings.title: Away detection delay
settings.description: How long to wait after a device drops off the router's client list before marking it "away". Too short and a brief signal drop can flap the state; too long delays detecting that someone left.

error.duplicate_nickname: This name is already used by another device: {nickname}. Enter a different name.
error.select_at_least_one: Select at least one device to add.
error.dhcp_failed: Could not change the reservation. See the error details below.
error.confirm_required: Select confirmation to delete this reservation.

abort.no_addable_devices: There are no new devices to add. There's nothing currently connected or reserved with a static IP that isn't already tracked.
abort.dhcp_unavailable: The router's current reservations could not be read. Try again later.
abort.dhcp_added: The DHCP reservation was added and verified on the router.
abort.dhcp_updated: The reservation was updated and verified on the router.
abort.dhcp_deleted: The reservation was deleted and verified on the router.
abort.dhcp_empty: There are no reservations to edit or delete.
abort.dhcp_changed: The list changed. Reopen it and choose a reservation again.
